appearances.snippet: That is so weird. Out of the Sackler family get all of this. I have to know, you know, their name was actually etched on the university at Tel Aviv University and then they took it down after the opioid crisis.

verification.notes: Tel Aviv University officially announced in June 2023 that it and the Sackler family agreed to remove the Sackler name from the Faculty of Medicine. The announcement followed years of opioid-crisis controversy surrounding Purdue and the family.
